type.name: FixedDecimal
type.storage: private Int64 coefficient plus UInt8 precision and UInt8 scale; no heap allocation
type.signedZero: not represented; every zero has coefficient 0 and formats without a minus sign

parse.input: one authenticated complete RFC 8259 number lexeme
parse.exactMode: any discarded nonzero decimal digit returns RoundingRequired
parse.overflow: range is tested after rounding; no saturation or wrap
parse.canonicalInput: noncanonical but valid RFC 8259 exponent and redundant fractional-zero spellings are accepted

format.scale: exactly scale digits follow the decimal point; trailing zeros are retained
format.integer: scale zero has no decimal point
format.zero: zero never carries a minus sign
format.canonical: no leading integer zeros except the single zero before a fractional point

arithmetic.addSubtract: operands require identical precision and scale and use exact checked coefficient arithmetic
arithmetic.multiply: caller supplies result precision, scale, and rounding; exact wide intermediate precedes one rounding step
arithmetic.rescale: caller supplies target precision, scale, and rounding; discarded digits are never silently rounded
arithmetic.overflow: checked against the target precision after the single declared rounding step

jsonApi: fixedDecimal(coefficient: Int64, precision: UInt8, scale: UInt8) -> Result<FixedDecimal, DecimalError>

transactionality.reader: token/value authenticity, precision, scale, rounding and overflow are resolved before returning the copyable scalar
transactionality.writer: canonical encoded length and output capacity are checked before first Writer mutation
transactionality.arithmetic: failure returns no partially initialized value

schemaMapping.fieldContract: each decimal field declares precision, scale, and rounding mode in its nominal user schema
schemaMapping.read: schema validation invokes valueFixedDecimal after member multiplicity and kind checks
schemaMapping.write: schema writer borrows FixedDecimal and emits its canonical fixed lexeme in schema field order
schemaMapping.ownership: FixedDecimal is a copyable bounded scalar; it neither borrows the JSON arena nor owns hidden storage

rejectedImplementations: lexeme-preserving output instead of value-and-scale canonical output
requiredPrimitive: signed exact intermediate of at least 128 bits for general precision-18 multiply and rescale

reference.provider: .NET BigInteger decimal arithmetic in the isolated verifier
